data.overview: In the early twentieth century, an eleven-year-old girl becomes convinced that oil lies beneath her supposedly worthless allotment. When speculators circle, she rallies relatives and wildcatters to protect the land and the wealth it brings.
data.tagline: She knew what the land was hiding.
data.title: The Hidden Oil Field
